supernacular.definition:
a. Like supernaculum; first-rate; as, a supernacular
   wine.

supernaculum.definition:
adv. & n. A kind of mock Latin term intended to mean,
   upon the nail; -- used formerly by topers.
adv. & n. Good liquor, of which not enough is left to
   wet one's nail.
supernaculum.translation:
adv. 一滴不剩地
n. 美酒

supernal.definition: a. being or coming from on high
supernal.translation: a. 天上的, 非凡的, 神圣的

supernatant.definition:
n. the clear liquid that lies above a sediment or precipitate
s. of a liquid; floating on the surface above a sediment or precipitate
supernatant.translation:
a. 浮在表面的
[医] [浮于]上层的, 上层清液

supernatants.definition:
plural of supernatant
n. the clear liquid that lies above a sediment or precipitate
s. of a liquid; floating on the surface above a sediment or precipitate
supernatants.translation:
(supernatant 的复数) a. 浮在表面的
[医] [浮于]上层的, 上层清液

supernatation.definition: n. The act of floating on the surface of a fluid.

supernational.translation: a. 由几个国家组成的, 控制几个国家的, 影响几个国家的

supernatural.definition:
n. supernatural forces and events and beings collectively
a. not existing in nature or subject to explanation according to natural laws; not physical or material
supernatural.translation:
a. 超自然的, 神奇的
[医] 超自然的

supernatural virtue.translation: [基督教]神学三德（即：有信、有望、有爱）之一

supernaturalism.definition:
n. a belief in forces beyond ordinary human understanding
n. the quality of being attributed to power that seems to violate or go beyond natural forces
supernaturalism.translation: n. 超自然性, 超自然主义

supernaturalist.definition: a. of or relating to supernaturalism

supernaturalistic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to supernaturalism.

supernaturalists.translation: n. 超自然主义者，超自然论者( supernaturalist的名词复数 )

supernaturality.definition: n. The quality or state of being supernatural.
supernaturality.translation: n. supernatural的变形；超自然状态；超自然性

supernaturalize.definition: v. t. To treat or regard as supernatural.

supernaturalness.definition: n. The quality or state of being supernatural.

supernaturals.definition:
plural of supernatural
n. supernatural forces and events and beings collectively
a. not existing in nature or subject to explanation according to natural laws; not physical or material
supernaturals.translation:
(supernatural 的复数) a. 超自然的, 神奇的
[医] 超自然的

supernidation.translation: [医] 着床过度(月经蜕膜增生过度)

supernilvar.translation: 尼尔瓦超低膨胀系数合金, 尼尔瓦超恒范合金, 超尼尔瓦铁镍钴合金

supernormal.definition:
s. beyond the range of the normal or scientifically explainable
s. exceeding the normal or average
supernormal.translation:
a. 非凡的, 异于寻常的
[医] 超常的, 逾常的

supernova.definition: n. a star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process

supernovae.definition: n a star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process

supernovas.definition: n a star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process
supernovas.translation: n. （天文中的）超新星( supernova的名词复数 )

supernumeraries.translation: n. 定额以外的人, 临时雇工( supernumerary的名词复数 )

supernumerary.definition:
n. a person serving no apparent function
n. a minor actor in crowd scenes
supernumerary.translation:
a. 额外的, 多余的
n. 跑龙套的角色, 杂工, 临时演员, 多余的人/物, 冗员

supernumerary adventitious bursae.translation: [医] 附加囊, 副囊, 磨擦囊, 偶发性粘液囊

supernumerary bone.translation: [医] 附加骨, 额外骨(如额外椎骨或颈肋)
